# The stock c172x's closed-loop flights of tests/control_flights.h through the legacy command path:
# name, world step, then latitude, longitude (rad), altitude (m), roll, pitch, yaw (rad),
# true airspeed (m/s), aileron, elevator, rudder, throttle. Recorded before the control
# architecture changed (docs/control-architecture.md, section 12.4); a real change moves
# them far more than a toolchain's last bits.
# The loiter's rows were recorded again for FA-1 (docs/flight-autonomy.md, section 14):
# near its circle it trims the carrot's until the circle flown is the one asked.

# sideslip on the rudder, rudder.beta_gain, is -1 per radian by default (it was +1, the wrong sign).
